Key outcome(s): To establish detailed cost profile for HIVDR testing and to identify cost drivers
Targeted Amplicon Deep sequencing (TADs) using Ion Torrent PGM with Illumina MiSeq reduced costs by 86% compared to conventional Sanger sequencing
Reagent costs per sequencing reaction and sequencer capital costs were lower for CEQ 2000 than Prism-377 and TruGene
Reagent cost per sample was less for Nanopore sequencing than for Illumina sequencing
